generic_domain.justification: Among the provided domains, 'markov chain' is the broader and more foundational concept within deep learning research. It is a fundamental probabilistic model that underpins many sequential decision-making processes and has applications across various domains such as reinforcement learning, natural language processing, and time series analysis. In contrast, 'markov games' are a specific application of Markov chains to game theory scenarios, making them a more specialized domain within the broader context of Markov models.
